subject.title: [Feature] Configurable thinking/reasoning block format per channel

question: Should reasoning presentation become a public per-agent or per-channel configuration surface, and which styles, precedence, and fallback semantics should that contract support?
rationale: Current main cleanly distinguishes reasoning payloads but intentionally has no public presentation contract; choosing configuration ownership and cross-channel semantics is a product decision rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Typed shared contract
options.body: Add a small transport-neutral style enum with italic default, an agent default, channel override, and documented capability fallbacks.

options.title: Telegram-only setting
options.body: Keep the option inside the Telegram plugin and support only Telegram-safe styles, avoiding a premature cross-channel contract.

options.title: Retain fixed rendering
options.body: Keep the current italic presentation and avoid adding another configuration surface.

recommendation.title: Typed shared contract
recommendation.body: Add a small transport-neutral style enum with italic default, an agent default, channel override, and documented capability fallbacks.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history and discussion evidence connects this person to both the reasoning pipeline and the prior product-direction review.
